title: Tests as data: ensuring AI-generated code does what we want
author: Martin Fowler (martin@martinfowler.com)
description: Automated testing in the age of AI coding assistants is problematic: when AI agents write both production and test code, developers risk losing the assurance that automated tests protect against functional errors. summary: Automated testing in the age of AI coding assistants is problematic: when AI agents write both production and test code, developers risk losing the assurance that automated tests protect against functional errors. All of this optimizes for human-readable tests that establish a contract between humans and AI.
